fv_double_population_cap.mechanism: fvd_cap_watch.py, started on X2-1 before the launch and polling each minute: when the coordinator is in phase index 2 and at most 8 of the 834 FV primary jobs are unfinished (826 or more records in validate_fv_primary/records), it runs production_runner control ROOT --workers 8, the overall worker target (multihost_a11.py line 920, enforced on every lease including the phase recheck). The control's transaction lock waits up to 30 s and then raises (multihost_a11.py 122 to 133), so the watcher retries the idempotent control with a growing pause until pull_state.json reads a control.max_workers at or below 8, the pass test, then exits. It reads the target before every attempt, so it never raises a lower target the operator set.
